brief: A sprawling, elaborate mechanical system dominates the canvas, featuring exposed workings of an immense clockwork automaton. The structure is assembled from shiny, oxidized brass, with crystalline shards inserted into gears and levers. The entire apparatus pulses with internal bioluminescence—a brilliant, cool glow that runs through the complex mechanism. Thin rubber bands are visible, forming connecting structures that seem both functional and delicate. The light emanates from the crystalline joints, giving the mechanical chaos a living, pulsing quality. Clicking anywhere on the canvas causes the glowing intensity to briefly brighten and the mechanical parts to shift into a new, momentary configuration.

statement: This sketch transforms the concept of mechanical complexity into a submerged jungle root system composed entirely of taut, folded origami structures. The viewer observes an intricate network of organic-looking root formations that appear to be constructed from carefully folded paper, creating a surreal blend between natural growth and precise craftsmanship. The system pulses with a cool bioluminescent glow that emanates from the crystalline junctions of the folded structures, giving the entire mechanism a living, breathing quality. When clicked, the entire structure briefly intensifies its glow and shifts into a new momentary configuration, emphasizing the dynamic interplay between rigid geometric forms and organic flow.
